paragraphs.source_en: Yoshirō stared at Shōan's lifeless face, a shudder passing through him. What would happen if Shōan and Sakata had sent someone to set the fire? When it came to such a deed, no one but Shōan and Sōshū would have dared attempt it. Merchants though they were, their blood ran hot. It was a disposition ingrained in men raised amid war, and their courage was in no way inferior to that of Kuroda Josui or Fukushima Masanori.
